scope: P2-50 one-ball diagnostic from nip through the common throat and external P2-49 collection ramp to sill Z285; no pile, retention, launch-feed or 5d gate mechanism claim

criteria.name: sill_reached
criteria.rationale: Requires the ball centre to reach the high opening rather than merely contact the lower ramp.

criteria.name: sill_speed
criteria.rationale: A small positive residual speed is required to cross the sill and fall into storage.

criteria.name: transition_bounce_gap
criteria.rationale: More than 20 mm airborne gap over X245..352 indicates that the piecewise -3 to steep-ramp transition needs a smooth-radius redesign.

criteria.name: throat_lateral_containment
criteria.rationale: The physical ramp is 80 mm wide; any centre excursion beyond 40 mm is loss from the throat.

diagnostics: ball speed relative to base at ramp base X approximately 0.325 m
ball speed relative to base at sill
maximum transition contact force and maximum airborne gap
contact-window D5065 current maximum, mean and saturation time per motor
nip crossing and sill arrival times
decision_rule: If any condition fails because of transition impact, bounce gap or loss before the sill, replace only the dependent P2-49 lower transition with a tangent smooth-radius curve, freeze a revision of this criteria file, and repeat the same nine-condition matrix.
